body.name: retained support-active normalization
body.construction: Apply \(N_H\) to \(G^{+}\) by evaluating each known selector multiplexer on \(E_H\), substituting only selector components constant over \(E_H\), and deleting only arguments unused in all registered executions. Form the raw carrier \(\Lambda_H\) independently as the product of the retained active and dormant primitive response-table simplices and latent-root simplices; derive \(g_H\), the supported observation map \(o_H^N\), the original-selector mass map \(s_H^N\), and the target map \(t_{a,H}^N\) from stored syntax; then impose the displayed intrinsic constraints defining \(\mathcal I_H\).
